title: incident-bot + slo-toolkit: add on-call helpers and runbook linking for automated diagnostics
author: Priya Kapoor
body: Motivation: improve on-call triage velocity by surfacing SLO/runbook context and lightweight helpers directly in incident-bot responses. This PR adds a set of on-call helper utilities to the slo-toolkit library, enhances runbook linking heuristics, and wires these into incident-bot's diagnostics flow so that automated diagnostics responses include prioritized runbook links and actionable next steps. Changes include: 1) new slo_toolkit.oncall.helpers module with utilities for scoring and ranking runbooks based on SLO context and recent telemetry; 2) runbook_linker improvements that match runbooks to alerts using fuzzy title/keyword matching and SLO tags; 3) incident-bot handler changes to attach top-3 runbook links and short remediation steps to autodx messages; 4) small telemetry and metrics additions to track click-through and oncall take-rate; 5) unit and integration tests and docs. Checklist: - [x] design review (ENG-3214) - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests against local incident-bot harness - [x] docs updated (README + runbook authoring notes) - [x] feature flagged behind slo_toolkit.oncall_v1 This work is intended to reduce blind triage time when an automated diagnostics message is posted, and to increase the fraction of incidents resolved with runbook steps. See linked Linear tickets for product acceptance criteria. Rollout plan: behind feature flag for 2 weeks in staging, opt-in beta for two SRE teams, monitor click-through and MTTR delta, then enable org-wide. Backcompat: existing autodx payloads unchanged if feature flag is off.
commits: feat(slo-toolkit): add oncall helpers module and README
feat(incident-bot): attach runbook links to autodx messages
perf(runbook_linker): cache fuzzy-match results and short-circuit on exact tag matches
test: add unit tests for helpers and integration test for end-to-end message payload
docs: update incident-bot runbook authoring guide and rollout notes
files_changed_summary: Added oncall helper utilities and unit tests
Improved runbook linker scoring with caching and SLO tag matching
Incident-bot now includes top-3 runbook links and short remediation text in autodx messages
Added metrics dashboard for runbook click-through and take-rate
review_comments: Ava Chen: Nice work; can you add a short circuit for exact SLO tag match to avoid fuzzy work?
Priya Kapoor: Added exact tag short-circuit and updated perf test to assert cache hit rate
Diego Martínez: Tests look good, please add a small e2e assertion for message size to ensure we don't exceed Slack limits
Priya Kapoor: Added e2e assertion and trimmed the runbook snippet template to fit 8KB channel limit
Samir Patel: Approve after resolving one nit about telemetry tag naming
Priya Kapoor: Renamed telemetry tags to 'runbook.ct' and 'runbook.take_rate' as requested
release_notes: Incident-bot: runbook linking and on-call helper utilities added. Automated diagnostics now include prioritized runbook links and short remediation steps behind feature flag 'slo_toolkit.oncall_v1'. Monitor runbook click-through and MTTR when enabling.
notes: Related Linear: ENG-3214 for acceptance criteria and rollout checklist
risk_and_mitigation: Low risk behind feature flag. Mitigations: initial opt-in and traffic ramp, revert flag if message volume or size regressions observed, and a fallback to not include runbook links if matching service is unavailable.
